paragraphs: He reported in the name of Rav Sheshet, Gittin 32a. Hyman says the name should also read Rabbah bar Ivo in Keritot 24b, where Rabbah bar Avuha appears in error.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The name to be emended is Rabbah bar Ivo versus Rabbah bar Avuha. Rav Sheshet is the authority in whose name he reports.

The whole Davidson Gittin 32a paragraph names Rabbah bar Ivo reporting in Rav Sheshet’s name and also gives the alternative Rabbah bar Avuha. The selected Keritot 24b paragraph names only Rabbah and does not itself prove the target patronymic. Hyman’s error judgment and “should read” retain their force and attribution; no whole-page absence or fresh Hebrew repair is claimed. The existing note remains verbatim.
